story.title: Our story
story.text: Abbasoglu Cleaning stands out in the market for its professional approach, systematic processes and guaranteed results.

vision.title: Our vision
vision.text: A custom plan is prepared for every site, and there is a quality-control stage. The price is based on the required standard, not the size of the site.

services.a: We offer a wide range of cleaning services, including residential cleaning, commercial and office centers, carpet washing, window cleaning and deep cleaning.

order.q: How do I book a cleaning service?
order.a: Booking is easy! You can schedule a convenient time online through our website, by phone or by email.

cancel.a: We understand that plans change. If you need to cancel or reschedule your appointment, please contact us at least 24 hours in advance.

sameTeam.q: Can I request the same cleaning team for every visit?
sameTeam.a: We strive to ensure continuity for our clients. If you prefer the same trained team for every cleaning, just let us know.

presence.q: Do I need to be at home (on site) during the cleaning?
presence.a: It's up to you! You can stay on site during the cleaning, or safely and reliably leave the process to us.
